source_paper_text:
Write G=C_n1+...+C_nr, with 1<n1|...|nr. Its rank is r and exponent e=nr. D is the least length forcing a nonempty zero-sum subsequence in every sequence over G; D*=1+sum_i(ni-1). Repetitions are allowed. s_le(h) is the least length forcing a nonempty zero-sum subsequence of length at most h.

Conjecture 6.2 (faithful mathematical restatement): Suppose r>=2 and D=D*. For every positive integer k with e<=D-k<=D: s_le(D-k)<=D+k if D-k>=(D+1)/2; otherwise s_le(D-k)>D+k.

title: Half-Davenport transition for short zero-sum sequences
